hooks.command:
cd "E:/SWD/capstone-tracking-backend" 2>/dev/null || exit 0
git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
[ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ] && exit 0
BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)
git add -A
if git commit -m "chore: auto-commit BE fixes" >/tmp/claude-auto-push.log 2>&1 && git push origin "$BRANCH" >>/tmp/claude-auto-push.log 2>&1; then
  echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Auto-committed & pushed to $BRANCH\"}"
else
  echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Auto-commit ran but push to $BRANCH failed - see /tmp/claude-auto-push.log\"}"
fi
